head.name: jacks-point-buildings
head.source: Queenstown Lakes District Council, Buildings_3D and Current_Building_Outlines (CC BY 4.0; from LINZ building outlines and LiDAR); OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) for kinds, names and uses
head.attribution: Contains data sourced from Queenstown Lakes District Council, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
head.note: Heights with heightFrom "lidar" are measured; "estimate" are typical values. Kinds with kindFrom "landuse" or "unknown" are not from the building itself.

groundHeights.from: Toitū Te Whenua LINZ elevation (Basemaps, terrain-rgb, zoom 16), CC BY 4.0
groundHeights.unit: decimetres above sea level; lines: the first height, then the step to each next position; outlines: the lowest, then how much higher the average and the highest are
